summary.goal: List all runs with status filtering, search, and quick actions. Entry point for navigating to specific run dashboards.

acceptance_criteria.description: Table/card list showing: status badge, plan name, duration, task count
Filter tabs: All, Running, Completed, Failed, Paused
Click row/card to navigate to run dashboard
Import Plan button opens pre-flight check
Real-time status updates via SSE (running runs update live)
Empty state with helpful message

observations: Similar to plans list in planner-ui
SSE subscription for running runs only
Use lighter RunListItem type for list performance - full Run type only on dashboard

architect.list_type: RunListItem is lighter than full Run - optimized for list rendering

steps.title: Define RunListItem type
steps.description: Create lighter type for run list items, separate from full Run type

acceptance_criteria.description: RunListItem type with fields: run_id, plan_id, plan_goal, status, task_count, completed_count, duration_ms, started_at, ended_at?
listRuns API returns RunListItem[] not full Run[]
Type exported from src/types/run.ts alongside Run type

architecture.rationale: Full Run includes tasks[], gates[], artifacts[] - too heavy for list view
architecture.pattern: List views use summary type, detail views fetch full entity

type_definition.plan_goal: string - extracted from plan for display
type_definition.ended_at: string | null - ISO timestamp, null if running

steps.title: Create RunCard component
steps.description: Card component displaying run summary information

acceptance_criteria.description: RunCard displays: status badge, plan goal (truncated), task progress (X/Y)
Duration shown: elapsed time for running, total time for completed
Status badge with color coding: running=cyan, completed=green, failed=red, paused=orange
Clickable card navigates to /forge/runs/:id
Hover state with border highlight
Uses RunListItem type, not full Run

specification.pattern_description: Similar card pattern with status badge and summary info

acceptance_criteria.description: Tabs: All, Running, Completed, Failed, Paused
Active tab highlighted with accent-cyan underline
Count badges on each tab showing number of runs in that status
Tab change updates URL query param (?status=running)

steps.title: Create useRuns hook
steps.description: Data fetching hook for runs list with filtering

acceptance_criteria.description: useRuns(filter?: { status?: string }) hook
Returns { runs: RunListItem[], isLoading, error, refetch }
Calls listRuns API with filter
Auto-refetches when filter changes

steps.title: Create useRunningUpdates hook
steps.description: SSE subscription for live updates to running runs

acceptance_criteria.description: useRunningUpdates(runIds: string[]) hook
Subscribes to SSE for each running run
Returns map of runId -> latest task counts
Cleans up subscriptions on unmount

architecture.pattern: Multiple SSE connections (one per running run)
architecture.optimization: Only subscribe to runs with status='running'

steps.title: Implement RunsListPage
steps.description: Main page component for runs list

acceptance_criteria.description: Header with title 'Forge Runs' and Import Plan button
StatusFilterTabs below header
Grid of RunCards (responsive: 1 col mobile, 2 cols tablet, 3 cols desktop)
Loading state shows skeleton cards
Error state shows ErrorMessage with retry
Empty state: 'No runs yet. Import a plan to get started.'

specification.pattern_description: Similar page structure with header, filters, grid

steps.title: Add Import Plan flow
steps.description: Button and navigation to start new run from plan

acceptance_criteria.description: Import Plan button in header (primary style)
Click opens modal with plan selector (list of published plans from Planner)
Select plan navigates to /forge/preflight/:planId
Modal fetches plans from Planner API: GET /api/plans?status=published

design.modal: Select a published plan to forge

api_integration.note: Cross-service call - see forge-ui-preflight for CORS/proxy config

acceptance_criteria.description: Pagination controls at bottom of list
Page size: 12 runs per page
Show total count: 'Showing 1-12 of 47 runs'
URL params for page: ?page=2

specification.pattern_description: Standard pagination pattern with prev/next buttons
